baseline_target_text: Erlauben Sie langsame oder blockierte Downloads, um verifizierte alternative Quellen zu verwenden. Soulseek-Peers verwenden sequenzielles Failover; Echtes Multipart-Chunking ist vertrauenswürdigen slskr-Mesh-Peers vorbehalten.

rationale: “Blockiert” means blocked rather than stalled, the current dative/infinitive construction is awkward, and the source distinguishes sequential failover from actual multipart chunking reserved for trusted mesh peers.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

proposed_target: Permita descargas lentas o detenidas para utilizar fuentes alternativas verificadas. Los pares Soulseek utilizan conmutación por error secuencial; la verdadera fragmentación multiparte está reservada para pares de malla slskr de confianza.
rationale: The exact help explains verified-source sequential failover and true multipart chunking; lowercasing the clause after the semicolon fixes the current capitalization without changing the feature meaning.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

baseline_target_text: Autorisez les téléchargements lents ou bloqués à utiliser des sources alternatives vérifiées. Les homologues Soulseek utilisent le basculement séquentiel ; le véritable regroupement en plusieurs parties est réservé aux homologues de maillage slskr de confiance.
proposed_target: Autorisez les téléchargements lents ou bloqués à utiliser des sources alternatives vérifiées. Les pairs Soulseek utilisent un basculement séquentiel ; le véritable téléchargement en plusieurs blocs est réservé aux pairs du maillage slskr de confiance.
rationale: The current “regroupement” means grouping, not downloading in chunks; the callout explains failover and reserves real multipart chunking for trusted mesh peers.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

baseline_target_text: सत्यापित वैकल्पिक स्रोतों का उपयोग करने के लिए धीमे या रुके हुए डाउनलोड की अनुमति दें। Soulseek सहकर्मी अनुक्रमिक विफलता का उपयोग करते हैं; ट्रू मल्टीपार्ट चंकिंग विश्वसनीय slskr मेश साथियों के लिए आरक्षित है।
proposed_target: धीमे या अटके हुए डाउनलोड को सत्यापित वैकल्पिक स्रोतों का उपयोग करने दें। Soulseek पीयर क्रमिक फ़ेलओवर का उपयोग करते हैं; वास्तविक मल्टीपार्ट खंड-डाउनलोड केवल विश्वसनीय slskr मेश पीयर के लिए आरक्षित है।
rationale: The current “विफलता” means failure and it leaves “true multipart chunking” untranslated; the source distinguishes peer failover from chunked download capability.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

baseline_target_text: Izinkan unduhan yang lambat atau terhenti untuk menggunakan sumber alternatif yang terverifikasi. Rekan Soulseek menggunakan failover berurutan; pemotongan multibagian yang sebenarnya dicadangkan untuk rekan mesh slskr yang tepercaya.
proposed_target: Izinkan unduhan yang lambat atau macet untuk menggunakan sumber alternatif terverifikasi. Peer Soulseek menggunakan failover berurutan; pengunduhan dalam beberapa bagian yang sebenarnya hanya tersedia bagi peer mesh slskr tepercaya.
rationale: “Rekan” means colleagues and “pemotongan” means cutting; the source means network peers and downloading a file in chunks.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

baseline_target_text: Permita que downloads lentos ou paralisados ​​usem fontes alternativas verificadas. Os pares Soulseek usam failover sequencial; o verdadeiro agrupamento multipartes é reservado para peers de malha slskr confiáveis.
proposed_target: Permita que downloads lentos ou parados usem fontes alternativas verificadas. Os peers do Soulseek usam failover sequencial; o fracionamento multipartes real fica reservado a peers confiáveis da malha slskr.
rationale: Remove the zero-width characters; “pares” means pairs and “agrupamento” means grouping, while the setting describes network peers and actual file chunking.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.

baseline_target_text: Cho phép tải xuống chậm hoặc bị đình trệ để sử dụng các nguồn thay thế đã được xác minh. Các đồng nghiệp Soulseek sử dụng chuyển đổi dự phòng tuần tự; phân đoạn nhiều phần thực sự được dành riêng cho các đồng nghiệp lưới slskr đáng tin cậy.
proposed_target: Cho phép các lượt tải chậm hoặc bị đình trệ dùng nguồn thay thế đã xác minh. Các peer Soulseek dùng cơ chế chuyển đổi dự phòng tuần tự; việc chia tệp thành nhiều khối thực sự chỉ dành cho các peer mạng mesh slskr đáng tin cậy.
rationale: “Đồng nghiệp” means colleagues and the current “phân đoạn” does not clearly say to split files into chunks; the source describes network peers and chunked downloads.
source_id: Allow slow or stalled downloads to use verified alternate sources. Soulseek peers use sequential failover; true multipart chunking is reserved for trusted slskr mesh peers.
